notes:
- Date and amount format in Settings › Appearance: by default the standard of your company's country (e.g. 21.10.2026 and 1.234,56); a chosen format is used in every list, report and amount field
- Tables fit the screen by default: text columns get narrower and long text ends with "…" (the full text shows on hover); amounts and dates keep their width; the "Fit to screen" button turns it off per table
- Pickers with icons and colors for record types, payment types, categories, due templates and projects; the most used choices come first
- Payment types: change their order with Move up / Move down, and give a payment type a shortcut (Ctrl+1…9) to choose it in entry forms
- Collections: the account's balance shows next to the account field; choosing installments by hand now fills the amount and takes only what is left of it
- Tabs: right-click a tab to close it, close the others or close all; the middle mouse button closes a tab
- Accounts list: a "Changed details" filter, and History in the row menu shows every change with date, time, old and new value and the user
- Cheques and notes: the type (cheque or note) shows with an icon and color
- Opening balances: carried-over cash, assets and account balances are separate tabs; assets owned before you started can also be entered after the first day close
- Gold and foreign currency in financial statements are valued at the last real rate, including the rate entered in the opening balances
- Network: a computer removed on the host is told so and can pair again from the login screen; "Set up this computer again" starts the setup over
- Download: the manual Windows ZIP now opens into a "LedgerPro" folder, and the package is smaller
- Fixed: "Reset data" removed the other users; a record showed matches released by earlier corrections; the program window reloads by itself after a display crash
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
